_about: Product rules for the two-lens synthesis (ENGINE_SPEC.md §7). Tables are read-only; these rules only choose what a reading may use.

exclude_rows.oc:avirati: Same word, different sense: YB 1.30 avirati (greed for objects) vs TS 7.1 / 8.1 avirati (absence of vows). Held out of readings until reviewed (tables report, onto-deep item 5).
exclude_rows.oc:pramada-pamada: Same word, different sense across the lenses (tables report, item 5). Held out of readings until reviewed.

note: In v1 every obstacle-correspondence row is related under P2-standpoint (computed by layers/_gen/tables), so readings show standpoint reconciliations; level, path and stage are accepted from the model engine only with packet cites.
